in_sanskrit.name: अर्पिता
in_sanskrit.meaning: दानपत्री, दानपत्रिका (offerer of gift, giver of gifts)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who offers gifts or performs charities.

in_hindi.name: अर्पिता
in_hindi.meaning: दानपत्री, दानपत्रिका (दान, दाना (gift), पत्र (leaf), ता (she), आ (is) (giver of gifts, offerer of gifts)

in_telugu.name: అర్పితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: దానపొయ్యేశ్వరి (Goddess of gifts, giver of gifts).

in_marathi.name: Arpita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arpita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arpita in Sanskrit translates to ‘love’ and ‘devotion’. In Hindu mythology, Arpita is the name of a Goddess who embodies the virtues of love and compassion. She is believed to bless her devotees with marital happiness and prosperity.
